references.text: The context for the requirement of unblemished sacrifices; the offering must be without defect to be accepted.
Continuation of the rules regarding unblemished sacrificial animals; details which defects disqualify an animal.
The burnt offering shall be a male without defect to be accepted by the Lord.
Also, small livestock offered must be a male without defect.
Peace offerings must also be without defect.
The sin offering requires a young bull without defect.
Animals with defects shall not be offered to the Lord your God.
Prohibition against offering animals with defects or anything evil; it is an abomination to the Lord.
The prophet Malachi rebukes the people for offering blind, lame, and sick animals in violation of God's command.
Condemnation of those who promise a good animal but offer one with a defect; God is a great King.
Christ as the unblemished sacrificial Lamb without defect or spot fulfills the requirements of the sacrificial laws.
Christ offered himself without blemish to God, pointing back to the requirement for unblemished sacrifices.
